meta.title: dsh-qgis-driver
meta.description:
从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机正在运行的 QGIS：在主线程执行代码、提交后台任务并轮询结果；实例通过插件注册表自动发现，无需地址或密钥。默认输入框右侧显示连接状态与权限开关，设置里可关闭挂件。
该插件由AI辅助生成

Drive the QGIS running on this machine from DeepSeek Harness - execute code on the QGIS main thread, submit background tasks, poll results, no address or key to configure.
AI Assisted.
